SELECT 'closure' k, CAST(closure_id AS VARCHAR) a, closure_type b, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) d, CAST(weeks_closed AS VARCHAR) e FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=108
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales', CAST(f.sale_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(f.quantity) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY f.sale_date
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.subcategory, p.valid_from pvf, p.valid_to pvt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT channel_code, staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, sum(quantity) q, min(quantity) mn, count(DISTINCT sku) skus, min(etl_loaded_at) e1, max(etl_loaded_at) e2 FROM l GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'RET', NULL, count(*), count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id), 0, sum(r.quantity_returned), min(r.quantity_returned), 0, NULL, NULL
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT 'dupes' k, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR) d FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at, s.store_id, p.subcategory
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31' ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 40

SELECT 'final' k, s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.quantity) units, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL

WHERE ps.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY ALL
